# DisasterAWARE

> An expanded full-text bundle of recent articles is available at [llms-full.txt](https://www.disasteraware.com/llms-full.txt) (~260 KB).

> DisasterAWARE is a real-time natural disaster, catastrophe, and climate risk intelligence platform built by the Pacific Disaster Center (PDC). It helps organizations monitor, assess, and respond to global hazards including tropical cyclones, earthquakes, floods, wildfires, tornadoes, tsunamis, and volcanoes. The platform serves enterprise risk managers, insurers, supply chain leaders, and government agencies with early warning alerts, exposure reports, damage assessments, and 300+ integrated GIS data layers across every ocean basin and continent.

DisasterAWARE provides both a SaaS platform (DisasterAWARE Enterprise) and a Data-as-a-Service API for integrating hazard intelligence into third-party systems. The platform's SmartAlert technology delivers geofenced notifications when specific threats intersect with an organization's assets, facilities, supply chain nodes, or employee populations. Post-catastrophe analytics powered by satellite imagery support insurance claims validation, parametric trigger assessment, and building-level damage assessment.

## Products

- [DisasterAWARE Enterprise](https://www.disasteraware.com/products-disasteraware-enterprise): Real-time disaster monitoring and intelligence platform with early warning alerts, interactive mapping, exposure reports, and 300+ data layers for natural disasters, severe weather, and physical threats.
- [Data as a Service (API)](https://www.disasteraware.com/products-data-as-a-service): Scalable API for integrating global disaster, catastrophe, severe weather, and physical threat intelligence into client platforms, with analytics and GIS mapping layers.
- [Asset Protection](https://www.disasteraware.com/asset-protection-capabilities): Tools to add facilities, set geofenced SmartAlerts, generate exposure reports, and extend hazard notifications to non-platform users.
- [Global Data Catalog](https://www.disasteraware.com/global-data-catalog): Catalog of real-time and historical natural disaster, climate risk, and physical threat analytics and exposure assessments available through the platform.

## Solutions

- [Critical Event Management](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions-critical-event-management): Strengthen critical event management with global disaster, severe weather, and threat intelligence to improve situational awareness, response, and organizational resilience.
- [Supply Chain Risk Management](https://www.disasteraware.com/our-solutions/solutions-supply-chain-management): Anticipate supply chain disruptions from natural disasters, severe weather, strikes, and protests by monitoring risks to suppliers, facilities, and transportation routes.
- [Insurance Catastrophe Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/our-solutions/insurance): Assess portfolio risk exposure, validate claims and parametric triggers, enhance catastrophe modeling, and improve underwriting with real-time and historical hazard data.

## Hazard Monitoring Capabilities

- [Tropical Storms & Hurricanes](https://www.disasteraware.com/monitoring-monitor-tropical-storms-with-disasteraware): Track hurricane and typhoon paths across all ocean basins, monitor estimated wind impact and storm surges, and assess exposure to assets and populations.
- [Earthquakes](https://www.disasteraware.com/monitoring-earthquakes-with-disasteraware-enterprise): Real-time earthquake alerts with shaking intensity, Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA), PAGER data, and automated exposure and damage reports.
- [Floods](https://www.disasteraware.com/monitoring-floods-with-disasteraware): Track global flood events with real-time and early warning alerts, flood risk layers, and automated exposure reporting.
- [Wildfires](https://www.disasteraware.com/monitoring-wildfires-with-disasteraware): Monitor active wildfires worldwide with satellite-based detection, real-time alerts, and exposure reports.
- [Tornadoes](https://www.disasteraware.com/monitor-tornadoes-with-disasteraware): Severe weather alerts with tornado lifecycle tracking including warnings, touchdown, paths, and damage assessment.
- [Tsunamis](https://www.disasteraware.com/monitoring-tsunamis-with-disasteraware): Real-time tsunami warnings from official sources with coastal risk data, travel time estimates, and automated asset alerts.
- [Volcanoes](https://www.disasteraware.com/monitor-volcanoes-with-disasteraware): Eruption alerts, ashfall forecasts, and volcanic risk intelligence from global observatory networks.

## Hazard Intelligence Landing Pages

In-depth landing pages on the explore sub-site that combine an interactive live hazard map with hazard-specific context (detection methodology, cascade effects, asset-protection use cases).

- [Tornado Intelligence](https://explore.disasteraware.com/tornado-intelligence): Verified tornado touchdown, path tracking, and damage assessment.
- [Wildfire Intelligence](https://explore.disasteraware.com/wildfire-intelligence): Live wildfire perimeters, PSPS monitoring, and smoke/cascade impacts.
- [Flood Intelligence](https://explore.disasteraware.com/flood-intelligence): AI-enhanced flood detection from news and satellite data, with global coverage.
- [Strike & Protest Intelligence](https://explore.disasteraware.com/strike-protest-intelligence): Civil-unrest monitoring with interactive map and impact analysis.
- [Historical Event Intelligence](https://explore.disasteraware.com/historical-event-intelligence): Access 342,000+ historical event records via the DisasterAWARE API for risk modeling and long-term analytics.

## Explore Sub-Site

- [Explore Live Hazards](https://explore.disasteraware.com): Interactive global map of all currently active hazards, plus risk profiles for 100 cities (50 US + 50 international) and all 50 US states based on FEMA National Risk Index and ThinkHazard data.
- [explore.disasteraware.com/llms.txt](https://explore.disasteraware.com/llms.txt): LLM-friendly index of the explore sub-site's 1,762 city, state, and hazard-risk pages.

## Machine-Readable Structure

Every page on `www.disasteraware.com` carries the following structured data:

- **Organization** JSON-LD (footer) — `@type: Organization`, name, logo, social `sameAs` links.
- **NewsArticle** JSON-LD on every weekly brief and content article — `@type: NewsArticle`, ISO 8601 `datePublished`, `image` (the article banner), `publisher` (DisasterAWARE), `mainEntityOfPage`.
- **Canonical** `<link rel="canonical">` on every page (UTM-stripped).

The `explore.disasteraware.com` sub-site adds **BreadcrumbList** JSON-LD on city, hazard-risk, and current-hazard pages, and per-page Open Graph images at `{page}/opengraph-image`.
